versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the vibe-coding skill, based on Google's open-source VibeCoding AI programming workflow.
- Provides a structured process for transforming requirements into code, featuring 20 specialized skills and 7 practical case studies.
- Emphasizes best practices: structured requirement analysis, research planning, test-first development, modular implementation, iterative optimization, and thorough review.
- Includes templates, checklists, recommended toolchains, and common pitfalls to guide all levels of developers.
- Offers real-world cases demonstrating efficiency and quality improvements with this AI-assisted workflow.
